entries.title: Shared/Core update: freebuff-model-policy-overlay

ai.title: Powerful models exclude solo session discount
ai.summary: The shared common package now defines `soloDiscountExcludedModelIds` on the Freebuff Freebucks wire type to identify Powerful models that do not receive the solo-session discount. A new `freebucksSoloDiscountFor` utility determines the discount for a model by checking if it belongs to the 'powerful' section or is explicitly listed in the excluded IDs. This utility replaces direct `soloDiscount` subtraction in `freebucksRowPrice` and `getFreebuffModelMeter` to ensure Powerful rows are charged in full while other rows retain the discount.
ai.evidence: The diff adds `freebucksSoloDiscountFor` to `common/src/util/freebuff-price-order.ts` which returns 0 when the section is 'powerful' or the model is in `soloDiscountExcludedModelIds`, and `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` adds `soloDiscountExcludedModelIds` to `FreebuffFreebucksInfo`.
ai.unknowns: The specific models designated as Powerful by the server are not listed in this diff, only the exclusion mechanism and picker section rule are defined.

eli5.text: Freebuff now identifies specific high-tier AI models that do not get the reduced price when you start a session alone. Previously, this discount applied broadly to solo sessions, but the system now explicitly excludes these more powerful models so they are charged at their full rate. This affects developers using the free tier who rely on these top-tier models, as their cost will no longer be lowered by the solo-session benefit. You will notice that starting a session with one of these specific models will deduct the full standard price from your credits instead of a discounted amount.
